newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World may take Southern Airline stake.
newsitem.headline: New World may take Southern Airline stake.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd said it was in discussions to take a strategic stake in China Southern Airline, an H-share listing candidate.

"New World Development is in discussions with Southern Airline of taking a stragetic stake in the airline," a spokesman from New World said. "It is still in a stage of discussion and no agreement has yet been reached."
The spokeman declined to comment on the size of the investment.

Market sources said strategic investors including New World Development and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd were expected to take a stake in Southern Airline, but no further details were available to the market.
A Hutchison spokeswoman declined to comment.

Sources said the airline was expected to issue more than one billion H-shares, raising about HK$4 billion, in a global flotation in the third quarter of 1997, but no listing details were immediately available.
H-shares are shares in China-incorporated companies for listing in Hong Kong.
